column1: # Names for packets: `build<TAB>opcode<TAB>NAME[<TAB>field,names]`; a client packet's opcode is written S75 for one build, or `*<TAB>hint:<identifier><TAB>NAME` for any build whose handler touches the identifier.
# A name is here only when the Java handler's behaviour shows what the packet is (what it sets, builds or runs), not from its size alone.
